If you need a reliable HVAC company in the Dallas, TX area, I’d prioritize companies with a strong local service history, clear upfront pricing, good recent customer reviews, and technicians who will diagnose the problem before pushing a full system replacement.

**My advice\:** Get two quotes for a major repair or replacement, and ask whether the diagnostic fee is applied toward the repair. If your AC or heat has stopped working completely, ask about same-day service and after-hours charges before booking.
